commit_message: fix(frontend): keep repository runs bound through draft PR
pr_title: fix(frontend): make Draft PR flow survive real repository runs
pr_body: Keeps one current-session repository job bound across long-running readback and reloads, resumes the same job instead of starting duplicates, preserves explicit Draft-PR publication consent, and removes the online intent interpreter as a hard blocker for user-owned repository actions.
